messages:
Evan: Quick ask — can someone run a regression/smoke bench on argosy-8b (new 8B we pulled) with 4k seq? Need P50/P95/P99 token lat and mem/allocs. Compare against baseline horizon-7b @ commit abc123. TL;DR: looking for any perf regressions after kernel scheduler change. Command suggestion: `./bench/run.sh --model argosy-8b --seq 4096 --batch 1 --iters 50 --trace perf.json`. Thanks :rocket:

Maya: On it. I'll kick off a smoke run on canary nodes (nv4s). Expect initial numbers in ~30m. Any specific prompts or prompt-catalog id?

Evan: Use prompt-set "dialog-long" (id: dlg-42). Also run `--warmup 5` and `--kv-warmup 1`. Capture p99 with outlier removal.

Maya: Got it. Starting now. Pinging @Liam in case infra tweaks needed.

deploy-bot: Started bench job 3344556680 for `argosy-8b` on canary-nv4s. Logs: https://ci.redwood/bench/3344556680 :gear:

Liam: Noted — last time we saw tail spikes from async queueing with this model. If you see sudden 10-20ms jumps, add `--disable-async-queue` in a follow-up. Also keep an eye on GPU mem fragmentation: `nvidia-smi` snapshots every 30s.

Maya: First smoke done. Quick numbers (single-run median of 50 iters): P50 12ms, P95 34ms, P99 88ms. GPU mem steady at 12.4GB, no OOMs. Attaching small summary below.

Maya: 
```
model argosy-8b @run 3344556680
seq=4096 batch=1 iters=50
tokens_per_sec: 700
latency_ms: p50 12 p95 34 p99 88
gpu_mem_mb: min 12345 max 12600
notes: minor jitter @iter 23 (spike to 140ms), trace uploaded
```

Priya: Nice. Can you run a compare job vs horizon-7b (same shard type) and post % delta on p95/p99?

Maya: Running compare now (horizon-7b baseline run id 3340001110). Expect in ~20m.

Maya: Compare results:
```
argosy-8b vs horizon-7b (same infra nv4s)
p50 delta: +6%
p95 delta: +12%
p99 delta: +35%
notes: p99 regression seems concentrated on long-prefix cases, likely KV cache misses around iter 23 spike.
```

Liam: +35% p99 is notable. Could be kernel scheduler interaction with KV eviction. Can you repro the spike deterministically with `--replay-trace perf.json --focus-iter 23`?

Maya: Replayed trace, reproduced spike. Stacktrace shows contention in `kv_cache::evict_batch()` — holds a global lock for ~40ms occasionally. Filing a ticket for runtime team.

sre-bot: Created ticket INF-3421 "argosy-8b p99 spike: kv_cache evict contention" assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://issues.redwood/INF-3421 :ticket:

Evan: Thanks. For next steps: (1) runtime should investigate lock-free eviction or finer-grained locks, (2) ops to test `--disable-kv-evict` as temporary mitigation, (3) we should block canary rollout until p99 delta < 15%. Thoughts?

Priya: Agreed. Also add a regression alert on p99 > 25% for future onboarding runs.

Liam: Ops can test `--disable-kv-evict` on a small canary tomorrow; curious if it increases memory.

Maya: Re-ran with `--disable-kv-evict`: p99 dropped to 92ms (~+18% vs horizon). GPU mem increased ~300MB. Quick numbers:
```
p50 13ms p95 36ms p99 92ms
gpu_mem +320MB
```

Evan: Good intermediate. I'm logging these numbers in the onboarding doc. @Priya can you update the model onboarding checklist, block rollout until runtime teams give a mitigation patch?

Priya: Done. Checklist updated and added INF-3421 link. :white_check_mark:

Evan: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up in the thread once runtime posts a patch or a mitigation plan. :eyes:
